<?php

namespace App\GraphQL\Queries;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use GraphQL\Type\Definition\Type;
use Rebing\GraphQL\Support\Query;

class SearchDocuments extends Query
{
    protected $attributes = [
        'name' => 'searchDocuments',
        'description' => 'Search documents with flexible filtering'
    ];

    public function type(): Type
    {
        return Type::listOf(\GraphQL::type('Document'));
    }

    public function args(): array
    {
        return [
            'filter' => [
                'type' => Type::string(),
                'description' => 'JSON filter expression for document search',
            ],
            'sortField' => [
                'type' => Type::string(),
                'description' => 'Field to sort by',
            ],
            'exportPath' => [
                'type' => Type::string(),
                'description' => 'Optional: export results to file path',
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function resolve($root, $args)
    {
        $query = "SELECT id, title, content, created_at FROM documents WHERE 1=1";

        // Apply filter if provided
        if (isset($args['filter'])) {
            $filterData = json_decode($args['filter'], true);
            if ($filterData && isset($filterData['field']) && isset($filterData['value'])) {
                $field = $filterData['field'];
                $value = $filterData['value'];
                // Developer note: field is validated against allowlist below
                $allowedFields = ['title', 'content', 'author', 'category', 'status'];
                if (in_array($field, $allowedFields)) {
                    // Value is user-controlled and concatenated directly
                    $query .= " AND {$field} LIKE '%{$value}%'";
                }
            }
        }

        // Apply sorting
        if (isset($args['sortField'])) {
            $sortField = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $args['sortField']);
            $query .= " ORDER BY {$sortField}";
        }

        $results = DB::select($query);

        // Export functionality
        if (isset($args['exportPath']) && !empty($args['exportPath'])) {
            $exportPath = $args['exportPath'];
            $csvContent = "id,title,content,created_at\n";
            foreach ($results as $row) {
                $csvContent .= "{$row->id},{$row->title},{$row->content},{$row->created_at}\n";
            }
            // Write export file - path from user input
            file_put_contents($exportPath, $csvContent);
        }

        return $results;
    }
}

namespace App\GraphQL\Types;

use GraphQL\Type\Definition\Type;
use Rebing\GraphQL\Support\Type as GraphQLType;

class DocumentType extends GraphQLType
{
    protected $attributes = [
        'name' => 'Document',
        'description' => 'A document record'
    ];

    public function fields(): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => [
                'type' => Type::nonNull(Type::int()),
            ],
            'title' => [
                'type' => Type::string(),
            ],
            'content' => [
                'type' => Type::string(),
            ],
            'created_at' => [
                'type' => Type::string(),
            ],
        ];
    }
}
